verdict.rationale: Workable provides a well-documented public REST API with numerous endpoints (jobs, candidates, offers, requisitions, permission_sets, webhooks) requiring scoped OAuth tokens, plus an llms.txt index and a first-party MCP server enabling agentic access. Probes confirm docs are live and machine-readable, though no OpenAPI/swagger spec was found. missing for 10: discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec, independent third-party corroboration of API robustness.
